attchmntText: XL Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of   Ms Juhi Balani (ACS 42751) as Company Sec of the company w.e.f. November 14, 2026.
voiceSummary: XL Energy Limited reports the outcome of its Monitoring Committee meeting held on November 14, 2026. The committee, along with the new board of directors, approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The statutory auditors, M/s. Pavuluri & Co., issued a Limited Review Report stating no material misstatements were found. The committee also approved the appointment of Ms. Juhi Balani as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective November 14, 2026. The meeting commenced at 04:00 PM and concluded at 05:15 PM.
